offering_description.value: Meridian Holdings offers sports betting, online casino gaming and prize competitions to consumers. It serves players through websites, mobile apps and betting shops. It also develops and licenses casino games and gaming software to other operators.

primary_products.value: digital casino games; gaming platform software

primary_services.value: online and retail sports betting; online casino gaming; paid-entry prize competitions

customer_segment.value: B2C: sports bettors, online casino players and prize competition entrants; B2B: online casino operators and gaming content aggregators

end_markets.value: sports betting; online casino gaming; prize competitions

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: sports wagers, casino play and paid competition entries; licensing or royalties: casino game content and gaming platform software licensed to operators
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: service provider: uses odds, casino content and prizes to run betting, gaming and competitions for consumers; software / platform: develops casino games and gaming platforms for operators and content aggregators

geography_served.value: global: Europe, Africa and Latin America, including the United Kingdom, Serbia and Mexico

specialization.value: related lines: sports betting, online casinos, prize competitions, casino game development and gaming software

distribution_channels.category: online; own locations; partners / resellers; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: high: sportsbook and online casino licensing by gambling regulators in each jurisdiction
